_doc: Motedis Aluprofil 20x20 B-Typ Nut 6: a 20 mm aluminium profile made to match Bosch Rexroth's 6 mm slot. Outer size, opening, slot depth, bore and the section figures are from Motedis' own data picture; what it does not print (lip, cavity width, corner radius) is Rexroth's figure and marked community. Motedis names no alloy ("Eloxiertes Aluminium"), so the material is the alloy such profiles are usually made of, said in its rule. The drawn outline leaves out the notches round the bore and the rib at each lip's tip.
